notes: A complete monochrome fictional institution, the Bureau of Unseen Places. The site combines an editorial introduction, a live procedural survey-plate generator with four landforms and two atmospheric controls, a collected archive with accessible detail dialogs, SVG downloads, responsive layouts, and reduced-motion support. All artwork is generated inline in the browser; there are no external assets or dependencies. Known limitations: system fonts vary slightly between operating systems, and JavaScript is required for the plate generator and archive.
